lens.label: Community area lens
lens.source: American Community Survey 2020–2024 (5-year estimates), Census tracts grouped into community areas.

lenses.note: Median home value and rent, weighted by owners and renters, ranked into thirds across Chicago. 2020–2024 survey estimates, not current prices.

Typical transit trip to the Loop leaving 8–9 am on a weekday, walking to the stop included (CTA ‘L’ and buses, Metra and the South Shore Line). Each spot counts its quickest arrival in the Loop: Union or Ogilvie, LaSalle/Van Buren, Clark/Lake, State & Madison or Millennium Station. Median across each community area.
lenses.source: CTA, Metra and South Shore Line schedules, routed with r5py.

lenses.note: Share of commuters who drive: under 50%, 50–68%, 68% or more (the same lines as the Toronto map). People who work from home aren’t counted.
Share of households that rent: under 35%, 35–60%, over 60%.

lang.label: Language at home
lang.note: English only, or the language besides English that each person 5 or older speaks at home. For small areas the Census groups some languages: Polish shares a group with Russian and other Slavic languages.
